{{for|other similarly named sword forms|Leopard in the Tree|Leopard's Caress}}
'''Leopard in High Grass''' is a [[sword form]]. It is a walking stance assumed when there are enemies on all sides. While in [[Canluum]], and agitated over the news of [[Edeyn Arrel]]'s political ploys, [[Lan Mandragoran]] unconsciously fell into this walking stance and scared off a horse groom.{{ref/book|0|16}}
